mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a2a_push_config (config_id, task_id, protocol_version, encrypted_payload, updated_at) VALUES (#{configId}, #{taskId}, #{protocolVersion}, #{encryptedPayload}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE task_id = VALUES(task_id), protocol_version = VALUES(protocol_version), encrypted_payload = VALUES(encrypted_payload), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
